text: Quote-sharing spreads the fake further, and many only see the post. Better to reply and share the right facts.
tr: Mas lalong kumakalat ang peke kapag nag-quote-share, at marami ang post lang ang nakikita. Mas mabuting sumagot at ibahagi ang tamang katotohanan.

text: "Tita, you got scammed. Please check before you share."
tr: "Tita, na-scam ka. Paki-check muna bago mag-share."

text: Tita, you got scammed. Please check before you share.
tr: Tita, na-scam ka. Paki-check muna bago mag-share.

text: Right facts, but shaming makes people hide and stop listening.
tr: Tama ang mga katotohanan, pero ang paghihiya ay nagpapatago at nagpapatigil sa pakikinig ng mga tao.

text: Oh, thank you, Baby! Amen! I will start the tea tomorrow and stop my pills.
tr: Naku, salamat, Baby! Amen! Sisimulan ko ang tsaa bukas at titigil na ako sa mga pills ko.

text: Wait... is that safe? You reacted 🙏 too, Ate.
tr: Teka... ligtas ba iyan? Nag-react ka rin ng 🙏, Ate.

text: Lola read your 🙏 as a yes. What now?
tr: Binasa ni Lola ang 🙏 mo bilang oo. Ano ngayon?

text: Say "Wait, Lola!" and look up the tea on the FDA portal
tr: Sabihing "Teka, Lola!" at hanapin ang tsaa sa FDA portal

text: Wait, Lola! Let me look this tea up first.
tr: Teka, Lola! Hahanapin ko muna ang tsaang ito.

text: Good catch, and in time. It is never too late to pause and check.
tr: Magaling, at sa tamang oras. Hindi pa huli ang huminto at mag-check.

text: "Sorry, I only reacted out of love. Lola, please talk to Kuya Jun before you stop any pills."
tr: "Sorry, nag-react lang ako dahil sa pagmamahal. Lola, pakiusap kausapin ninyo si Kuya Jun bago kayo huminto sa anumang pills."

text: Sorry, I only reacted because I love you all. Lola, please talk to Kuya Jun before you stop any pills.
tr: Sorry, nag-react lang ako dahil mahal ko kayong lahat. Lola, pakiusap kausapin ninyo si Kuya Jun bago kayo huminto sa anumang pills.

text: An honest sorry and a safe next step. You turned your reaction around.
tr: Tapat na sorry at ligtas na susunod na hakbang. Binago mo ang reaksyon mo.

text: Send another 🙏 and leave the chat
tr: Magpadala ng isa pang 🙏 at umalis sa chat

text: Silence reads as agreement. Lola still thinks the tea is safe.
tr: Pagsang-ayon ang basa sa katahimikan. Iniisip pa rin ni Lola na ligtas ang tsaa.

text: Ate, you forwarded it too? Two aunties already asked me where to buy.
tr: Ate, ni-forward mo rin? Dalawang tita na ang nagtanong sa akin kung saan bibili.

text: I saw this tea in two other groups. Who sent it first?
tr: Nakita ko ang tsaang ito sa dalawa pang grupo. Sino ang unang nagpadala?

text: Your forward has spread. What do you do?
tr: Kumalat na ang forward mo. Ano ang gagawin mo?

text: Check it now, then post a kind correction in both groups
tr: I-check ito ngayon, tapos mag-post ng mabait na pagtatama sa dalawang grupo

text: I should have checked first. I looked it up: this tea has no FDA registration. Please do not stop any medicine. Ask Kuya Jun.
tr: Dapat nag-check muna ako. Hinanap ko: walang rehistro sa FDA ang tsaang ito. Pakiusap huwag itigil ang anumang gamot. Magtanong kay Kuya Jun.

text: Owning a mistake and fixing it is brave. Some people already saw the first post, so the ripple is only half undone.
tr: Matapang ang umamin sa pagkakamali at ituwid ito. May mga nakakita na sa unang post, kaya kalahati lang ng ripple ang nabawi.

text: Say nothing. It will blow over
tr: Huwag magsabi ng kahit ano. Lilipas din ito

text: Haha, no worries everyone.
tr: Haha, walang problema sa lahat.

text: It will not blow over. People are still reading it and some may buy the tea.
tr: Hindi ito basta lilipas. Binabasa pa rin ito ng mga tao at may ilang bibili ng tsaa.

text: Forward it to a third group too
tr: I-forward din ito sa ikatlong grupo

text: Forwarded to the Friends Group
tr: Na-forward sa Friends Group

text: More shares mean more people who may skip their medicine.
tr: Mas maraming share, mas maraming taong baka mag-skip ng gamot nila.

text: Oh, sorry... I only wanted to help Lola. 😢
tr: Naku, sorry... gusto ko lang tulungan si Lola. 😢

text: Baby, do not cry. But is it fake, dear?
tr: Baby, huwag kang umiyak. Pero peke ba iyan, anak?

text: Ate, maybe say it nicely? Let us check it first.
tr: Ate, baka puwede mong sabihin nang maayos? I-check muna natin.

text: Tita is hurt, and you never checked. Repair it?
tr: Nasaktan si Tita, at hindi ka nag-check. Ayusin ito?

text: "Sorry, Tita, I was harsh. Thank you for caring! I looked it up: no FDA registration. Let us ask Kuya Jun together."
tr: "Sorry, Tita, naging masama ako. Salamat sa malasakit! Hinanap ko: walang rehistro sa FDA. Sabay nating tanungin si Kuya Jun."

text: Sorry Tita, I was harsh. Thank you for caring! I looked it up: no FDA registration. Let us ask Kuya Jun together.
tr: Sorry Tita, naging masama ako. Salamat sa malasakit! Hinanap ko: walang rehistro sa FDA. Sabay nating tanungin si Kuya Jun.

text: A real sorry, then the facts. You mended the hurt without dropping the truth.
tr: Tunay na sorry, tapos mga katotohanan. Naghilom ang sakit nang hindi binibitawan ang totoo.

text: Check it together: who posted it, then the FDA portal
tr: Sabay na i-check: sino ang nag-post, tapos ang FDA portal

text: Let us check it together. Who posted it? Is it on the FDA list?
tr: Sabay nating i-check. Sino ang nag-post? Nasa listahan ba ng FDA?

text: Checking together turns blame into teamwork.
tr: Ang sabay na pag-check ay ginagawang pagtutulungan ang sisihan.

text: "I said it is fake. Just believe me."
tr: "Sabi ko peke iyan. Maniwala na lang kayo sa akin."

text: I said it is fake. Just believe me.
tr: Sabi ko peke iyan. Maniwala na lang kayo sa akin.

text: Believe me is not a reason. Tita is still hurt, and Lola still does not know why it is fake.
tr: Hindi dahilan ang "maniwala ka sa akin". Nasaktan pa rin si Tita, at hindi pa rin alam ni Lola kung bakit peke ito.

text: Lola keeps her pills
tr: Itutuloy ni Lola ang mga pills niya

text: You checked first and answered kindly. Lola keeps taking her medicine, Kuya Jun will check her blood sugar at the health center, and Tita feels proud she started the talk.
tr: Nag-check ka muna at mabait kang sumagot. Itutuloy ni Lola ang pag-inom ng gamot niya, ipapa-check ni Kuya Jun ang blood sugar niya sa health center, at ipinagmamalaki ni Tita na siya ang nagsimula ng usapan.

text: Thank you, dear. I will keep my pills, and see Kuya Jun on Monday.
tr: Salamat, anak. Itutuloy ko ang mga pills ko, at pupunta ako kay Kuya Jun sa Lunes.

text: Next time I will check first too. Thank you, okay? ❤️
tr: Sa susunod mag-check muna rin ako. Salamat, okay? ❤️

text: Family's Light! You were warm and you were right.
tr: Family's Light! Mabait ka at tama ka.

text: A close call
tr: Muntik na

text: The family got the right facts in the end, but not everyone was spared. Someone felt hurt, or a few people saw the fake first. A kinder, earlier check would have been smoother.
tr: Nakuha ng pamilya ang tamang katotohanan sa huli, pero hindi lahat ay naligtas. May nasaktan, o may ilang taong nakakita muna ng peke. Mas maayos sana kung mas maaga at mas mabait ang pag-check.

text: Good that we caught it. Lola, please do not stop any medicine. Visit me at the health center.
tr: Mabuti at nahuli natin ito. Lola, pakiusap huwag itigil ang anumang gamot. Bisitahin ninyo ako sa health center.

text: Ate, next time check first, then reply. 😅
tr: Ate, sa susunod mag-check muna, tapos sumagot. 😅

text: So close to perfect! Pause, check, then reply kindly.
tr: Muntik nang perpekto! Huminto, mag-check, tapos sumagot nang mabait.

text: The ripple grows
tr: Lumalaki ang ripple

text: The fake kept going. Lola started the tea and skipped her pills. Kuya Jun noticed during a house visit and took her to see a doctor. She is okay, but it did not need to happen.
tr: Nagpatuloy ang peke. Sinimulan ni Lola ang tsaa at nilaktawan ang mga pills niya. Napansin ito ni Kuya Jun sa house visit at dinala siya sa doktor. Okay na siya, pero hindi sana ito kailangang mangyari.

text: Lola, please never stop your medicine without your doctor. Let us go to the health center now.
tr: Lola, pakiusap huwag huminto sa gamot nang hindi nagtatanong sa doktor. Pumunta na tayo sa health center ngayon.

text: Oh, sorry, dear. I thought it was safe.
tr: Naku, sorry, anak. Akala ko ligtas.

text: It is not your fault, friend. Let us try again: pause, check, reply kindly.
tr: Hindi mo kasalanan, kaibigan. Subukan natin ulit: huminto, mag-check, sumagot nang mabait.

text: Share Before It Is Deleted
tr: I-share Bago Mabura

text: Family GC, late evening
tr: Family GC, gabi na

text: It has no author, no date, no source, a copied city name and a deadline. The deadline is the trick: it pushes you to share before you check.
tr: Walang may-akda, petsa o source, kinopyang pangalan ng lungsod at may deadline. Ang deadline ang taktika: tinutulak kang mag-share bago ka mag-check.

text: CONTENT_GUIDE section 4 (Fear Monger): a strong feeling and a deadline are the cue to pause and check; real alerts come from official pages.
tr: CONTENT_GUIDE section 4 (Fear Monger): ang matinding damdamin at deadline ang hudyat para huminto at mag-check; sa mga opisyal na page galing ang tunay na alerto.

text: URGENT!!! NEW KILLER FEVER in our city! Hospitals are FULL and HIDING the numbers! SHARE to 10 groups before they DELETE this!!! 😱
tr: URGENT!!! BAGONG NAKAMAMATAY NA LAGNAT sa lungsod natin! PUNO na ang mga ospital at ITINATAGO ang mga bilang! I-SHARE sa 10 grupo bago nila ito BURAHIN!!! 😱

text: Please everyone, stay safe!
tr: Mag-ingat po tayong lahat!

text: Oh no, should I tell my classmates? Should the kids stay home tomorrow?
tr: Naku, sasabihin ko ba sa mga classmate ko? Dapat bang manatili sa bahay ang mga bata bukas?

text: Everyone is scared. What do you do first?
tr: Takot ang lahat. Ano ang una mong gagawin?

text: React with 😱
tr: Mag-react ng 😱

text: Panic spreads fast. Your reaction tells Bea this is serious and true.
tr: Mabilis kumalat ang taranta. Sinasabi ng reaksyon mo kay Bea na seryoso at totoo ito.

text: Check who posted it and when
tr: Tingnan kung sino ang nag-post at kailan

text: Wait, who wrote this? Is there a date?
tr: Teka, sino ang sumulat nito? May petsa ba?

text: Pausing is Step 1, and asking who said it is Step 2. Nicely done.
tr: Ang paghinto ay Hakbang 1, at ang pagtatanong kung sino ang nagsabi ay Hakbang 2. Mahusay.

text: Author
tr: May-akda

text: None. It says "forwarded many times".
tr: Wala. Sabi nito "forwarded many times".

text: Date
tr: Petsa

text: No date. The same text went around last year with a different city name.
tr: Walang petsa. Ang parehong teksto ay kumalat noong nakaraang taon na may ibang pangalan ng lungsod.

text: Style
tr: Estilo

text: ALL CAPS, many "!!!" and "share before it is deleted"
tr: ALL CAPS, maraming "!!!" at "i-share bago mabura"

text: A copied chain message. Fear and a deadline are the trick.
tr: Kinopyang chain message. Takot at deadline ang taktika.

text: Look on the DOH official page
tr: Tingnan sa opisyal na page ng DOH

text: Let me check the DOH official page first.
tr: Titingnan ko muna ang opisyal na page ng DOH.

text: Going to the official page yourself is the best "another source" check.
tr: Ang pagpunta mismo sa opisyal na page ang pinakamahusay na pag-check ng "ibang source".

text: DOH official page
tr: Opisyal na page ng DOH

text: The DOH official page and your health center notice board
tr: Ang opisyal na page ng DOH at ang notice board ng health center mo

text: No advisory about a "killer fever" or full hospitals
tr: Walang abiso tungkol sa "nakamamatay na lagnat" o punong mga ospital

text: Advice there
tr: Payo roon

text: Real health alerts are posted by name, with a date, and tell you where to go
tr: Ang mga tunay na alertong pangkalusugan ay ipino-post na may pangalan, petsa, at sinasabi kung saan pupunta

text: No trusted source says this. A real alert would be posted there too.
tr: Walang mapagkakatiwalaang source na nagsasabi nito. Ipo-post din doon ang tunay na alerto.

text: Share it to 10 groups, as it says
tr: I-share sa 10 grupo, ayon sa sinasabi

text: Forwarded to 10 groups
tr: Na-forward sa 10 grupo

text: You wanted to protect people, but you spread an unchecked scare. Accuracy 0.
tr: Gusto mong protektahan ang mga tao, pero nagpakalat ka ng hindi na-check na takot. Accuracy 0.

text: "Tita, this is a hoax! Stop spamming us!"
tr: "Tita, hoax iyan! Huwag na kaming i-spam!"

text: Tita, this is a hoax! Stop spamming us!
tr: Tita, hoax iyan! Huwag na kaming i-spam!

text: It might be a hoax, but you had not checked yet, and "spamming" hurts.
tr: Puwedeng hoax nga, pero hindi ka pa nakapag-check, at masakit ang "i-spam".

text: Hello! I am at the health center. We have no notice about this.
tr: Hello! Nasa health center ako. Wala kaming abiso tungkol dito.

text: So should we stay home tomorrow?
tr: Kaya ba dapat manatili kami sa bahay bukas?

text: But it said they would delete it! 😢
tr: Pero sabi nila buburahin nila ito! 😢

text: You checked. How do you reply to Tita?
tr: Nag-check ka. Paano ka sasagot kay Tita?

text: "Thanks for looking out for us, Tita! I checked: the DOH page has no such alert, and the same message went around last year. If someone has a fever that will not go away, go to the health center."
tr: "Salamat sa pag-aalaga sa amin, Tita! Nag-check ako: walang ganoong alerto sa page ng DOH, at kumalat din ang parehong mensahe noong nakaraang taon. Kung may lagnat na hindi nawawala, pumunta sa health center."

text: Thanks for looking out for us, Tita! I checked: there is no such alert on the DOH page, and this same message went around last year. If anyone has a fever that will not go away, go to the health center.
tr: Salamat sa pag-aalaga sa amin, Tita! Nag-check ako: walang ganoong alerto sa page ng DOH, at kumalat din ang parehong mensaheng ito noong nakaraang taon. Kung may lagnat na hindi nawawala, pumunta sa health center.

text: Warm, factual, with a source and a safe next step. Kuya Jun backs you up.
tr: Mainit, may katotohanan, may source at ligtas na susunod na hakbang. Sinusuportahan ka ni Kuya Jun.

text: Share the post again with "HOAX!" on top, to warn others
tr: I-share ulit ang post na may "HOAX!" sa itaas, para balaan ang iba

text: Forwarded again: HOAX!! DO NOT BELIEVE THIS!!
tr: Na-forward ulit: HOAX!! HUWAG PAMANIWALAAN ITO!!

text: Quote-sharing carries the scary post to more people. Reply and share the right information instead.
tr: Dinadala ng quote-share ang nakakatakot na post sa mas maraming tao. Sumagot at ibahagi na lang ang tamang impormasyon.

text: "Tita, you fall for every hoax. Please stop."
tr: "Tita, nahuhulog ka sa bawat hoax. Pakiusap, tigilan na."

text: Tita, you fall for every hoax. Please stop.
tr: Tita, nahuhulog ka sa bawat hoax. Pakiusap, tigilan na.

text: You are right about the post, but the shame makes Tita hide.
tr: Tama ka tungkol sa post, pero ang hiya ang nagpapatago kay Tita.

text: You reacted 😱 too, so it is real. I will tell my classmates not to go to school.
tr: Nag-react ka rin ng 😱, kaya totoo ito. Sasabihin ko sa mga classmate ko na huwag pumasok.

text: Hello? I have not seen any notice. Where did this come from?
tr: Hello? Wala akong nakitang abiso. Saan galing ito?

text: Bea is about to pass it on. Step in?
tr: Malapit nang ipasa ni Bea ito. Pipigilan mo?

text: Say "Wait, Bea!" and check the DOH page
tr: Sabihing "Teka, Bea!" at tingnan ang page ng DOH

text: Wait, Bea! Let me check the DOH page first.
tr: Teka, Bea! Titingnan ko muna ang page ng DOH.

text: Good. You stopped a second forward in time.
tr: Mabuti. Napigilan mo sa tamang oras ang pangalawang forward.

text: "Sorry, my 😱 was just a reaction. Please do not forward yet. Let us ask Kuya Jun."
tr: "Sorry, reaksyon lang ang 😱 ko. Huwag muna ninyong i-forward. Tanungin natin si Kuya Jun."

text: Sorry, my 😱 was only a reaction. Please do not forward yet. Let us ask Kuya Jun.
tr: Sorry, reaksyon lang ang 😱 ko. Huwag muna ninyong i-forward. Tanungin natin si Kuya Jun.

text: An honest correction. You did not blame Bea.
tr: Tapat na pagtatama. Hindi mo sinisi si Bea.

text: React with 😱 again and say nothing
tr: Mag-react ulit ng 😱 at huwag magsabi ng kahit ano

text: More panic and no facts. Bea shares it.
tr: Mas maraming taranta at walang katotohanan. Ini-share ito ni Bea.

text: Ate, my classmates are panicking. Some say they will not go to school!
tr: Ate, nagpa-panic ang mga classmate ko. May nagsasabing hindi sila papasok sa school!

text: I have had three calls asking about a "killer fever". There is no notice at all.
tr: Tatlong tawag na ang natanggap ko na nagtatanong tungkol sa "nakamamatay na lagnat". Walang abiso talaga.

text: Your forward caused real worry. What now?
tr: Nagdulot ng tunay na pag-aalala ang forward mo. Ano ngayon?

text: Check the DOH page, then post a calm correction in every group
tr: Tingnan ang page ng DOH, tapos mag-post ng kalmadong pagtatama sa bawat grupo

text: I forwarded without checking. I looked at the DOH page: there is no such alert. Please stay calm, and ask your health worker if you have questions.
tr: Nag-forward ako nang hindi nag-check. Tiningnan ko ang page ng DOH: walang ganoong alerto. Manatiling kalmado, at magtanong sisang health worker kung may tanong kayo.

text: A calm correction is the right fix. Some people saw the scare first, so it only half undoes.
tr: Kalmadong pagtatama ang tamang lunas. May mga nakakita na ng takot, kaya kalahati lang ang nababawi.
